summary: C-MLP-04 (OWNER-CONTROL-CENTER-NEUTRAL-01): miners reach the Control Center and choose what to mine, and nothing there is battery-only. scripts/install_miner.sh takes a clean Linux machine through a machine check, the locked environment and local builds of the pinned images to a running Control Center, and records the images for setup; the Control Center reopens the miner's written setup on restart, and website/get-started is the website's page for it (deployment separate). A miner needs no operator file: setup reads Carbon's testnet and its publisher (UID 0 of a finalized snapshot) into miner-network.json, and every campaign entry point binds through carbon.development_session.miner_network. Everything that differs by Challenge (feedback modes and schema, the validator intake check, GPU and rented-GPU scopes) is read from that Challenge's registered campaign; the Launchpad and MCP doors import no Challenge module, profiles carry per-Challenge intakes and validators (legacy battery_* fields read as before), GPU practice is set up for a Challenge the miner names and never launches another, and the catalog shows every Challenge's profiles, research provisions and setup offers alike. Only implemented Challenges launch; the rest are shown and refused with the registry's code. The retired Burgers identity left the pre-launch review. Engineering evidence only; the fresh-machine run is a person's, and nothing is qualified or written to the chain.
